Hero_Desc_Chloe:
A tailor sprite who comes second to none when it comes to fashion.
She has a scary obsession with her doll, Sebastian.
She's selective about who she hangs out with due to her fussy personality, but she is very thorough when it comes to her work.
Album_Like_Chloe: A doll she just finished and seems perfect only to her.
Album_Hate_Chloe: The imperfection of her doll that turned out a little later.
Album_Wish_Chloe: Reclaiming her memories completely, to recall the figure of the flawless and perfect doll.
Album_Chloe1: Don't be fooled by her innocent gaze. Contrary to her lovely appearance, Chloe is quite a relentless sprite. Her obsession with dolls is without equal.
Album_Chloe2: Chloe's personality isn't bad, but she tends to be self-centered. She doesn't care about others' opinions or attention. She only keeps marching toward her goals.
Album_Chloe3: I once witnessed Chloe violently tearing apart and hitting Sebastian, a giant doll she always takes with her. Sebastian... is really a doll, right? I cautiously asked if something had happened, but she ignored me, clutching Sebastian with a sorrowful face. I don't know Chloe's true personality.
Album_Chloe4: One day, Chloe brought Sebastian and asked me if I noticed anything different. I couldn't notice anything, which made her scowl. Chloe insisted that I take a sewing class as I failed to notice the new buttons and thread patterns she had added to Sebastian.
Album_Chloe5: When I showed interest in Sebastian by saying it looked cute, Chloe puffed up with pride. But soon after, she suddenly burst into tears. Panicked, I tried to comfort her, only for her to say she was dissatisfied with Sebastian's finishing work and start snipping parts of it.
Album_Chloe6: Chloe has been giving me a piercing gaze lately. I can't tell if she's glaring at me for something I did wrong or simply watching me. When I asked, she confessed that she was just observing. As a side note, I also learned she had gotten into a fight with a certain collector sprite during one of her observations.
Album_Chloe7: Chloe has been feeling down lately, unsure of what exactly she wants to create. She longs to craft a doll that truly satisfies her, but she can't clearly picture what it should look like. I guess creativity does come with suffering.
